name: Beached ships
description: A gameplay change (off by default; set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page). A warship at one of your own colonies can be ordered to Beach on colony (right-click it, or its fleet). It crash-lands and stays on the planet as a grounded fortress for good: it cannot be refloated. Its crew joins the colony's garrison (a defend strength from the hull's size and armour and the crew's level), and its guns keep firing at hostile ships in orbit like a base's, but only while no ground battle runs on the colony (the crew is fighting on the ground); they fire again once the colony holds. Each beached ship scars the colony: its quality falls by 2% (a small frigate) to 8% (a big capital), at most 4 ships and 20% in all. An empire with the terraforming technology can clean the scars up over about a year, for a fee (the colony's Clean up order). AI empires beach a ship only as a very last resort: a valuable colony about to be overrun, its orbital forces certain to be wiped out, and a ship that cannot get away or is badly damaged.

flags.name: beachingAI
flags.label: AI empires beach ships as a last resort and clean up
